title: Sleeping Gods: Distant Skies
subtitle: The Standalone Cooperative Open-World Aerial Campaign
tagline: Explore drifting sky islands, battle strange beasts, and seek a way home aboard a 1930s cargo plane.
loreSummary: San Francisco, 1937. A routine cargo flight plunges through a strange atmospheric anomaly, marooning your crew in a surreal realm of floating islands, slumbering deities, and bizarre technology. Exploring aboard a vintage airplane and on foot, you will read branching story encounters, build specialized combat decks, and uncover ancient totems to find your way back home.
keyFeatures: Standalone sequel to Sleeping Gods featuring seamless open-world exploration by air and on foot
Streamlined combat system utilizing personal character decks, equipment, and status synergies
Massive story atlas and storybook containing hundreds of quests, secrets, and branching endings
Modular camping system allowing intuitive quick-saving and dynamic party progression

distant_skies_full_campaign.name: Full Aerial Odyssey (~12 Expeditions)
distant_skies_full_campaign.description: The complete narrative campaign exploring the skies, recovering ancient totems, and fleeing the Wandering Skies.

distant_skies_maiden_flight.name: Maiden Expeditions (5 Expeditions)
distant_skies_maiden_flight.description: Play the first 5 sessions repairing your plane, discovering initial floating ruins, and building character decks.

distant_skies_complete_atlas.name: Complete Atlas & Hidden Temples (16 Expeditions)
distant_skies_complete_atlas.description: An exhaustive exploratory campaign seeking out every remote sky island, dungeon, and lost deity.

milestones.title: The Floating Archipelago

milestones.title: Sanctuary of the Sky Gods
